title.zh-TW: 那斯達克100盤中一度跌入熊市，美股收盤跌幅收斂
title.en: Nasdaq-100 briefly hits bear territory before US stocks pare losses

summary.zh-TW: 感恩節前夕科技股續遭賣壓。25日那斯達克100指數盤中最深跌約4.7%，距高點約兩成，收盤跌幅收斂至約0.6%；道瓊漲0.33%至50,182.95點，標普跌0.25%至7,182.78點，那斯達克跌0.62%，費半跌0.65%至8,774.86點。輝達盤中跌逾9%，收跌3.9%至149.30美元；甲骨文跌5.1%、美光跌4.5%。10年期美債殖利率降至約4.845%。
summary.en: Ahead of Thanksgiving, the Nasdaq-100 fell up to about 4.7% intraday on Nov. 25, about 20% off its peak, then closed roughly 0.6% lower. The Dow rose 0.33% to 50,182.95, the S&P 500 slipped 0.25% to 7,182.78, the Nasdaq lost 0.62% and the SOX 0.65% to 8,774.86. Nvidia, down over 9% intraday, closed 3.9% lower at US$149.30; Oracle fell 5.1% and Micron 4.5%.

impact.zh-TW: 盤中跌入熊市後拉回，顯示低接買盤仍在但AI類股波動極高；美股週五提前收盤，台股電子權值股恐持續隨美股科技股震盪。以上為市場推論。
impact.en: The intraday bear-market dip and rebound suggest dip buyers remain but AI-stock volatility is extreme; with a shortened US Friday session, Taiwan tech heavyweights may keep tracking US tech swings. Market inference.

title.zh-TW: 美第3季GDP上修至4.3%，10月PCE年增3.8%強化升息預期
title.en: US Q3 GDP revised up to 4.3%; October PCE at 3.8% reinforces hike bets

summary.zh-TW: 美國商務部經濟分析局將第3季實質GDP年化成長率上修0.9個百分點至4.3%，主要來自投資與政府支出。10月PCE物價指數月增0.3%、年增3.8%，符合預期並追平三年高點；核心PCE年增3.3%，高於預期0.1個百分點。個人所得增0.7%，優於預期。聯準會9月已升息、10月按兵不動，報導指12月升息機率大增。
summary.en: The BEA revised US Q3 real GDP growth up 0.9 points to an annualized 4.3%, driven mainly by investment and government spending. October's PCE price index rose 0.3% m/m and 3.8% y/y, in line with forecasts and matching a three-year high; core PCE rose 3.3% y/y, 0.1 point above expectations. The Fed hiked in September and held in October; reports say a December hike now looks very likely.

impact.zh-TW: 強勁成長加上通膨黏著，使12月升息預期升溫，高評價科技股的估值壓力可能延續；實際決策以聯準會12月會議為準。以上為市場推論。
impact.en: Strong growth and sticky inflation lift December hike expectations, which may keep pressure on richly valued tech stocks; the actual decision rests with the Fed's December meeting. Market inference.

title.zh-TW: 美擬以產能過剩為由對14經濟體加徵關稅，台灣擬15%
title.en: US proposes overcapacity tariffs on 14 economies, with Taiwan at 15%

summary.zh-TW: 中央社引述金融時報與法新社報導，美方提議依產品清單對14個貿易夥伴課徵最高20%關稅：中國與越南最高，台灣、韓國、日本與歐盟為15%，印度17%，東南亞數國18%，新加坡10%。美國貿易代表葛里爾稱稅率大致與既有貿易協議相當，部分可能小幅上調。中國外交部反駁「產能過剩」說法。目前為提案，尚未生效。
summary.en: Citing the FT and AFP, CNA said the US proposed tariffs of up to 20% on product lists from 14 partners: China and Vietnam highest, Taiwan, South Korea, Japan and the EU at 15%, India 17%, several ASEAN nations 18%, Singapore 10%. USTR Jamieson Greer said rates roughly match existing trade-deal levels, with some possibly a few points higher. These are proposals, not enacted tariffs.

impact.zh-TW: 若稅率維持與既有協議相近，對台出口衝擊或有限，但最終清單、豁免範圍與中國反制仍具不確定性，電子供應鏈可能持續受消息面干擾。以上為推論。
impact.en: If rates stay close to existing deals, the hit to Taiwan's exports may be limited, but final product lists, exemptions and any Chinese response remain uncertain and may keep weighing on electronics supply-chain sentiment. Inference.

title.zh-TW: 台股重挫1,926點跌破年線，成交量逾1.18兆元
title.en: TAIEX plunges 1,926 points below its annual line on NT$1.19 trillion turnover

summary.zh-TW: 受美股晶片股重挫拖累，台股25日盤中最多跌3,440.45點，收盤跌1,926.92點至38,195.43點，為史上第6大收盤跌點，跌破約39,551點的年線，成交值約1.1881兆元。台積電跌3.59%至2,150元，聯發科跌停至3,645元，鴻海跌8.83%至206.5元。投顧主管認為12月升息已部分反映，新關稅方案多屬既有稅率重新包裝，屬個人看法。
summary.en: Dragged by the US chip rout, the TAIEX fell as much as 3,440.45 points on Nov. 25 and closed down 1,926.92 at 38,195.43, its sixth-largest point drop ever and below the annual line near 39,551, on turnover of about NT$1.1881 trillion. TSMC fell 3.59% to NT$2,150, MediaTek hit limit-down at NT$3,645 and Hon Hai lost 8.83% to NT$206.5. An adviser said a December hike is partly priced in (opinion).

impact.zh-TW: 大量下跌顯示籌碼面劇烈換手，權值股短線波動加大；後續走勢可能取決於美股科技股能否止穩及升息、關稅消息。以上為市場推論。
impact.en: Heavy-volume selling points to sharp position turnover and higher near-term volatility in heavyweights; the next leg may hinge on whether US tech stabilises and on rate and tariff news. Market inference.

title.zh-TW: 川普將出席台積電亞利桑那擴廠典禮，德州設廠仍在評估
title.en: Trump to attend TSMC Arizona expansion ceremony; Texas fab still under evaluation

summary.zh-TW: 經濟日報引述彭博，白宮官員表示川普將出席12月4日台積電亞利桑那廠擴建典禮，董事長魏哲家等高層將與會，黃仁勳是否出席未確認。另據路透，台積電已向德州申請稅務優惠，文件涉及布拉索斯郡規劃約226億美元、2奈米以下製程新廠；台積電表示德州投資仍在討論評估中。
summary.en: Citing Bloomberg, Economic Daily News said White House officials expect Trump to attend TSMC's Arizona expansion ceremony on Dec. 4, with Chairman C.C. Wei; Jensen Huang's attendance is unconfirmed. Separately, Reuters said TSMC sought Texas tax incentives for a planned US$22.6bn fab in Brazos County for 2nm or more advanced chips; TSMC said a Texas plan is still under evaluation.

impact.zh-TW: 典禮為預定活動、德州廠尚未定案；美國擴產有助回應關稅與在地生產壓力，但也可能帶來資本支出與毛利率稀釋疑慮。以上為推論。
impact.en: The ceremony is a scheduled event and the Texas fab is not finalised; US expansion may ease tariff and onshoring pressure but could raise capex and margin-dilution concerns. Inference.

reason.zh-TW: 報導直接提及其亞利桑那擴廠典禮與德州設廠評估，且25日隨大盤下跌3.59%，可觀察美國擴產進度與關稅消息對股價的影響。
reason.en: Reports directly cover its Arizona expansion ceremony and Texas fab evaluation, and it fell 3.59% with the market on Nov. 25; watch how US expansion and tariff news affect the stock.

risk.zh-TW: 德州廠尚未定案；海外擴產可能稀釋毛利率，AI類股估值修正與升息預期亦可能加大波動。
risk.en: The Texas fab is not finalised; overseas expansion may dilute margins, and AI valuation resets and hike expectations could add volatility.

reason.zh-TW: 報導指其25日跌停至3,645元，是台股重挫中跌幅最重的權值股之一，可觀察美股晶片股與關稅消息是否持續牽動。
reason.en: Reports say it hit limit-down at NT$3,645 on Nov. 25, among the hardest-hit heavyweights; watch whether US chip moves and tariff news keep driving it.

risk.zh-TW: 短線賣壓與籌碼調整可能延續；美國關稅提案細節未定，終端需求亦存不確定性。
risk.en: Near-term selling and position adjustments may persist; US tariff details are unsettled and end demand remains uncertain.

reason.zh-TW: 報導指其25日下跌8.83%至206.5元；作為AI伺服器組裝要角，可觀察美國AI類股修正與關稅提案對其評價的影響。
reason.en: Reports say it fell 8.83% to NT$206.5 on Nov. 25; as a major AI server assembler, watch how the US AI-stock correction and tariff proposal affect its valuation.

risk.zh-TW: AI資本支出疑慮、美國關稅與在地生產要求，可能影響營運與股價波動。
risk.en: AI capex doubts, US tariffs and onshoring demands could affect operations and add share-price volatility.

reason.zh-TW: 輝達、甲骨文等AI相關美股大跌，市場對AI基礎建設支出的疑慮可能牽動伺服器代工族群；美國關稅提案也與其出口相關。此為產業推論，報導未直接提及。
reason.en: Sharp drops in Nvidia, Oracle and other US AI names may weigh on server makers via AI-infrastructure spending doubts, and the tariff proposal bears on exports. Industry inference; reports do not name the company.

risk.zh-TW: 推論未經公司證實；雲端客戶資本支出調整、關稅與匯率變動皆可能影響獲利。
risk.en: The link is inferred, not confirmed by the company; cloud capex changes, tariffs and FX could hit earnings.

reason.zh-TW: 資料中心電源與散熱屬AI基礎建設供應鏈，美國AI類股修正與升息預期可能影響市場對相關需求與評價的看法。此為產業推論。
reason.en: Data-center power and cooling are part of the AI infrastructure chain; the US AI correction and hike expectations may shift views on demand and valuation. Industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 推論未經公司證實；高評價在利率上升環境下易受壓，AI需求放緩或關稅變化亦為風險。
risk.en: The link is inferred, not company-confirmed; high valuations are vulnerable when rates rise, and slower AI demand or tariff changes are risks.
